## 简体中文

### Director Mode 扫码连接修复

- macOS 会稳定触发“本地网络”权限请求，并在权限被拒绝时显示明确的处理提示。
- macOS 优先使用正在运行的实体网卡地址，并兼容企业网络等非传统私有 IP 网段。
- Windows 进入 Director Mode 后会自动启动网页控制端，无需先点击 Start。
- Windows 会过滤 VPN、Hyper-V、WSL、Docker 等虚拟网卡，避免二维码包含手机无法访问的地址。
- 网页服务启动失败或端口被占用时，界面会显示实际错误状态。

## English

### Director Mode QR connection fixes

- macOS now reliably requests Local Network access and shows actionable guidance when permission is denied.
- macOS prefers active physical network interfaces and supports corporate networks that use non-RFC1918 IPv4 ranges.
- Windows starts the web controller automatically when Director Mode opens; clicking Start first is no longer required.
- Windows filters VPN, Hyper-V, WSL, Docker, and other virtual adapters so the QR code uses an address reachable from a phone.
- The interface now reports real web-controller startup and port-binding errors.

### Downloads

| Platform | File |
| --- | --- |
| macOS | `InterviewAssistant-1.1.2-macOS.dmg` |
| Windows (recommended) | `InterviewAssistant-1.1.2-Windows-x64-Setup.exe` |
| Windows (portable) | `InterviewAssistant-1.1.2-Windows-x64.exe` |

> The Windows build is not code-signed yet. If SmartScreen appears on first launch, click **More info → Run anyway**.
